dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit thin, high-intensity light perimeters with darker interior cores. The edges are jagged and exhibit sharp gradient transitions against the dark pelt background, particularly along the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, observed as small scattered points primarily along the lower ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A distinct obtuse triangle is formed by the centroids of three primary macro-annuli located on the upper-central flank, with a secondary linear alignment of three smaller ring structures following the curvature of the dorsal line.
